name: Iron Tortoise Style (Combat, Style)
body:
You guard yourself and allies with your trusty shield at your side.

Prerequisites: Bluff 3 ranks, proficiency with shields, one Iron Tortoise stance known.

Benefit: You deal damage with shield bash attacks as though you were one size larger than you actually are. This stacks with other effects that increase you or your weapons’ size.
